meta.name: Sourdough Chocolate Chip Cookies
meta.description: Soft and chewy chocolate chip cookies using sourdough starter for depth and tang. Butter plus oil for maximum chewiness.

change_log.summary: Initial recipe adapted from The Clever Carrot sourdough chocolate chip cookies

states.title: Whisk Dry Ingredients
states.direction: In a medium bowl, whisk together all-purpose flour, bread flour, baking powder, baking soda, and fine sea salt.
states.exit_condition: Dry ingredients evenly combined with no visible clumps

notes.text: The blend of AP and bread flour gives structure from bread flour's higher protein while keeping cookies tender from the AP flour.

states.title: Cream Butter and Sugars
states.direction: In the stand mixer with paddle attachment, beat softened butter with brown sugar and granulated sugar on medium speed until light and fluffy, about 4 minutes.
states.exit_condition: Mixture is light in color, fluffy, and increased in volume

states.title: Add Wet Ingredients
states.direction: To the stand mixer, add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Then add oil, sourdough starter, milk, and vanilla. Mix until fully incorporated.
states.exit_condition: Wet ingredients fully incorporated into a smooth, slightly loose batter

notes.text: Works with either active bubbly starter or refrigerated discard. Active starter adds slight leavening; discard adds mainly flavor.

states.title: Combine Dough
states.direction: Add the dry ingredients from the medium bowl to the stand mixer in 2-3 batches, mixing on low speed until just combined after each addition.
states.exit_condition: No visible dry flour streaks remain; dough is cohesive but not overworked

notes.text: Do not overmix. Overmixing develops too much gluten, making cookies tough. Stop as soon as flour disappears.

states.title: Fold in Chocolate
states.direction: Using a wooden spoon or rubber spatula, fold the chopped chocolate into the dough until evenly distributed.

states.title: Chill Dough
states.direction: Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour.
states.exit_condition: Dough is firm and cold to the touch, holds shape when scooped

notes.text: You can skip the chill for a quicker bake — cookies will spread more and be thinner/chewier.
Dough can also be chilled overnight for more developed sourdough flavor.

states.title: Preheat Oven
states.direction: Position rack in upper third of oven, about 15cm from heat source. Preheat to 350°F (175°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
states.exit_condition: Oven reaches 350°F (175°C) and baking sheets are lined

states.title: Scoop Cookies
states.direction: Using a cookie scoop, portion dough into ~30g balls. Roll gently and place on parchment-lined baking sheets, spaced 5cm apart.
states.exit_condition: Dough portioned into uniform ~30g balls on lined sheets

notes.text: Freeze extra dough balls on a sheet, then transfer to a zip bag. Bake from frozen — add 1-2 minutes to bake time.

states.title: Bake
states.direction: Bake one sheet at a time for 11-12 minutes, until edges are light golden brown and centers appear slightly underbaked.
states.exit_condition: Edges light golden, centers look slightly underbaked and puffy

notes.text: Cookies firm up significantly as they cool. Pull them when they still look underdone in the center.

states.title: Cool and Garnish
states.direction: Let cookies cool on the baking sheet for 15 minutes. Sprinkle with flaky sea salt while still warm, then transfer to a wire rack.
states.exit_condition: Cookies are set and cool enough to handle; salt adhered to surface

methods.detail: 10-15 seconds on a plate. Warms through and re-softens the center.
350°F (175°C) for 3-4 minutes on a baking sheet. Refreshes the crisp edges.
